name: orchbot
description: Desktop workspace local-first para agentes de IA persistentes
author: Orchbot Team <support@orchbot.local>

scripts.package:dir: bun run build && electron-builder --linux dir --config electron-builder.json
scripts.package:appimage: bun run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --config electron-builder.json
scripts.package:deb: bun run build && electron-builder --linux deb --config electron-builder.json
scripts.package:dmg: bun run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.json
scripts.package:exe: bun run build && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.json
scripts.package:feed: bun run build && electron-builder --publish never --config electron-builder.json
